A workaround was posted by someone a few days ago, but it seems to have disappeared so here it is again. The workaround was to downgrade mathlib to a specific commit, here is the lakefile setting that worked for me (Lean v4.35.0-rc3):

[[require]]
name = "mathlib"
scope = "leanprover-community"
rev = "c55e6e786f49471c72fbddbec5415808896aec1e"
Thanks! But I would rather not do this. I will prefer to wait until this issue get fixed (hopefully soon?)
